final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT c.district_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS client_count FROM client AS c JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = c.district_id GROUP BY c.district_id, d.A3), step2 AS (SELECT region, SUM(client_count) AS region_count FROM step1 GROUP BY region), step3 AS (SELECT s1.district_id, s1.region, s1.client_count, CAST(s1.client_count AS REAL) / NULLIF(s2.region_count, 0) AS region_share FROM step1 AS s1 JOIN step2 AS s2 ON s1.region COLLATE BINARY = s2.region COLLATE BINARY), step4 AS (SELECT SUM(client_count) AS total_count FROM step3) SELECT s3.district_id, s3.region, s3.client_count, s3.region_share, CAST(s3.client_count AS REAL) / NULLIF(s4.total_count, 0) AS overall_share FROM step3 AS s3 JOIN step4 AS s4 ON s4.total_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY overall_share DESC LIMIT 10
